description: p8's input with `ｂｙ` (U+FF42 U+FF59, fullwidth b and y) added beside `by`, with the same value, to the attestation by the attestor outside the parties. NFKC folds the name to `by`, but names are never normalized, so it is a name an attestation does not define and the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p8 is the accepting twin. An engine that normalizes names with NFKC or NFKD before comparing them accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
